name: Crater floor — Séítah / Máaz
description: Crater interior; Séítah 18.4382°N, 77.4421°E. About -2,600 m; traverse variation ~13 m; Séítah domes up to 17 m above Máaz. Boundaries approximate, from published zone descriptions.
chemistry: Séítah MgO 21.4 wt%, olivine CIPW 41.1 wt%, Fo54–72, grain 1.5 mm; Máaz MgO 2.7 wt%, plagioclase 37.9 wt%

name: Western delta + Kodiak
description: West wall, mouth of Neretva Vallis; Kodiak 18.4124°N, 77.3820°E; delta front 18.4410°N, 77.4120°E. Fan top above floor; rim wall 610 m above delta base. Boundaries approximate, from published zone descriptions.
chemistry: Carbonate 3–9 wt% (Upper Fan); Fe/Mg clay in delta sediments

name: Margin Unit — ancient shoreline
description: Inner rim edge; Mandu Wall 18.4630°N, 77.3560°E. 265 m explored span; a long sloping bench, not a cliff. Boundaries approximate, from published zone descriptions.
chemistry: Carbonate 6–16 wt%; PIXL MgO 21±10 wt% (E) / 26±12 wt% (W); CaSO4 + fluorite veins ~25 cm, eastern Margin only; 3 water events

name: Neretva Vallis + Bright Angel
description: Channel through western rim; Bright Angel on N and S edges; Neretva breach 18.4720°N, 77.3420°E. Channel 400 m wide; Bright Angel exposure 1.2+ km; Cheyava Falls rock 1.0 × 0.6 m, sol 1212. Boundaries approximate, from published zone descriptions.
chemistry: Organic carbon + phosphorus; vivianite + greigite leopard spots (mm-scale); CaSO4 veins run the length of Cheyava Falls; Sapphire Canyon core sol 1215, 6.2 cm — POTENTIAL biosignature only, not confirmed life

name: Rim + Broom Point
description: Outer rim; Broom Point — location by zone + traverse, no lat/lon in PDFs. +300 m to Aurora Park, +800 m total relief at Lookout Hill; slopes up to 23°. Boundaries approximate, from published zone descriptions.
chemistry: Igneous / impactite; Silver Mountain, Green Gardens (serpentinite), Main River cores from rim

name: Octavia E. Butler Landing hub
description: 18.4446°N, 77.4509°E. -2,570 m (reported), 30 m above general floor. Landing 18 Feb 2021; ~1.9 km east of delta remnants; landing ellipse 7.7 × 6.6 km. Boundaries approximate, from published zone descriptions.
chemistry: Máaz paver field; MOXIE site; first weather report site
